# Research plan templates

Every output carries status draft, version, date, an evidence table and a Gaps and open questions section, following the handoff standard. No file holds a participant's name or contact details.

## Research questions (research-plan/research-questions.md)

The ID is in the first column and the text in the second.

```
| ID | Question (about users, not the product) | Gap or assumption IDs | How the assumption is tested, source and next step | Decisions it informs | Rank | Decision on the question (keep, merge or cut) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <RQ-NN> | <question> | <AS-NN> | <test, source, next step> | <decisions from the objectives> | <rank, with the working> | <blank until a person decides> |
```

## Aims and exit condition (research-plan/aims.md)

```
## Aims
| Aim ID | Aim: so that <role> can decide <decision> | Question IDs |
|---|---|---|
| <AIM-NN> | <aim> | <RQ-NN, RQ-NN> |

## Exit condition
| Finding that would end or redirect the project | Evidence it would take | Role with authority to stop or redirect | Set on |
|---|---|---|---|
| <finding, for example no user need found> | <evidence> | <role, blank until named> | <YYYY-MM-DD, blank until set> |
```

## Participant plan (research-plan/participants.md)

```
| Group | Why this group (aim or question IDs) | How many | Inclusion criteria | Exclusion criteria | Access confirmed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <criteria only, no names> | <IDs> | <n> | <criteria> | <criteria> | <yes, no or To verify> |

Participant mix passed to persona scoping: <summary by group and count>
```

## Supporting documents (research-plan/documents/)

```
Discussion guide: purpose and framing; consent reminder; opening questions; questions grouped by aim, each citing its RQ ID; closing; notes for the facilitator.
Screener: criteria from the participant plan turned into questions, with the answers that include or exclude.
Consent form: draft wording for approval by <role from the local config file>. Not final until approved.
```

## Research plan (research-plan/research-plan.md)

```
# Research plan: <project or round>

Status: draft until signed
Version: <n> | Date: <YYYY-MM-DD>
Signer role: <role, name blank until signed> | Signed on: <YYYY-MM-DD, blank until signed>

## Purpose and objectives
<From the agreed objectives, handoff H01.>

## Aims
<From aims.md.>

## Research questions
<From research-questions.md, by ID.>

## Exit condition
<From aims.md.>

## Participants
<From participants.md.>

## Method and procedure
To verify. <Role that will choose methods.>

## Schedule
<Dates. To verify if not confirmed.>

## Supporting documents
<File names and status.>

## Changes collected from the sponsor and stakeholders
| Change | Proposed resolution | Decision | Effect on scope |
|---|---|---|---|

## Evidence
| Item ID | Claim | Source | Evidence tag | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Gaps and open questions
- <Unconfirmed access, missing methods, when the plan is revisited.>
```
